answer: Day after day the dairy maid carries the milk pails from the byre to the dairy on a yoke, setting the pails down square on the dairy stones. Cheese milk milk strainer rind bond governs the carrying: a bond milk milk strainers lodge after straining room trials. The marble works the yoke, the atlas works the carrying, the cipher works the pails. A cheat must do 71 false yokes and 71 false carryings.
